geography: Worldwide (Sarepta net product revenue for the product; no regional split printed per product)
moa: Phosphorodiamidate morpholino oligomer (PMO) antisense that skips exon 53 of the dystrophin gene

approval_evidence.quote: NDA 211970 ACCELERATED APPROVAL Sarepta Therapeutics ... for Vyondys 53 (golodirsen) injection ... (electronic signature page dated 12/12/2019)

series_end_reason: From the second-quarter 2024 Form 10-Q on, Sarepta's product revenue note and MD&A table print EXONDYS 51, VYONDYS 53 and AMONDYS 45 only as one combined line, 'PMO Products' (note: 'EXONDYS 51, VYONDYS 53 and AMONDYS 45 (collectively, the PMO Products)'; Q2 2024: 'Total PMO product revenues, net $238,827' thousand). The last quarter with the product's own line is 2024Q1. Scanned every 10-Q, 10-K and 8-K exhibit filed 2024-05 to 2026-09 for a per-product figure and found none. Evidence: PMO Products | $ | 238,827 | $ | 238,988 | $ | (161 | ) (Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2024, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/873303/000095017024092720/srpt-20240630.htm)
search_log: Listed Sarepta (CIK 0000873303) filings via data.sec.gov/submissions (recent + older files): every 8-K and 8-K/A from 2016-10 on (all items; exhibits of each fetched and searched for product-level net product revenue) and every 10-Q, 10-K, 10-Q/A, 10-K/A from 2016-11 on.
The issuer's IR site (investorrelations.sarepta.com) could not be reached from this environment (connection failed through the proxy), so no IR-site release was consulted.

10-Q/10-K product tables are in thousands; Q4 is the 10-K full year less the nine months of the third-quarter 10-Q (annual_less_reported_first_nine_months); the 10-Q/A for 2018Q2 is exhibit-only (no financial change).

Cross-checks measured: EXONDYS 51 + VYONDYS 53 equals the printed 'Products, net' line in 2020Q1-Q4 and 2019Q4; EXONDYS 51 + VYONDYS 53 + AMONDYS 45 + ELEVIDYS equals 'Total product revenues, net' in 2021Q1-Q3 and 2021Q4 to 2023Q4 (Q4 = full year less nine months), 2022Q1-Q3, 2023Q1-Q3 and 2024Q1.

2019Q4 (115 thousand USD) is the full-year 2019 figure in the FY2021 10-K three-year table less a nil nine months; the 2019 10-K says 'we had commenced shipment of VYONDYS 53 but revenue ... was immaterial'. The nil nine-month figure is inferred from the approval date (the combined 'Product, net' for nine months 2019 equals EXONDYS 51 alone); the quarter ties to the printed Q4 2019 'Product, net' of 100,113 = 99,998 (EXONDYS 51) + 115.
2020Q1-Q3 are prior-year columns of the 2021 10-Qs because the 2020 10-Qs print only 'Products, net'; 2020Q4 derived from FY2020 (33,858) less nine months 2020 (18,889).
